newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-BOURSE STILL CONSIDERING CONTINUOUS TRADE.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-BOURSE STILL CONSIDERING CONTINUOUS TRADE.

text.p: The Latvian stock exchange said that it is still considering when and how to launch continuous trade in Latvian stocks.
The market at the moment has a price fixing session in the morning and then further bids or offers can be entered later. The trade lasts from 10 in the morning until 12.
"The bourse's Board is currently considering the issue of introducing on-going trade but without any deadlines specified," bourse president Uldis Cerps told Reuters.
"It would be a decision of our Council, when it comes," he added.
The stock exchange yesterday announced the composition of its new index, which will have nine companies and be calculated from April 2 last year.
